description: Figure 5, titled "entropyavggraphstatic.png", is a bar chart that compares the average entropy across five different models: Baseline, Source Info, Direct Command, Rationale, and Sycophancy. The horizontal axis lists these five models, while the vertical axis represents the average entropy, with a scale ranging from 0 to 1.2 in increments of 0.2. The chart shows that the Rationale model has the highest average entropy, with a value of approximately 1.1. The Sycophancy model has the second-highest entropy, at about 1.0. The Direct Command model has an entropy of approximately 0.9. The Baseline and Source Info models have the lowest entropy values, both around 0.8. The bars are colored in a light blue shade.
